context: Two managers prep a recruiting drive
purpose: Teach: 申込み/選抜/院長/アナリスト/アドバイザー/部数/直行/配備

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今回の選抜、申込み数、過去最多だ。
lines.en: This selection round hit an all-time high in applications.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient delivery. Slight lift on 「all-time high」—announcing good news without fanfare. Professional but warm underneath. The tone of someone who's checked the numbers twice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: アナリスト枠とアドバイザー枠、別管理してます。
lines.en: We're managing the analyst and advisor slots separately.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, reassuring. Quiet confidence in process. Even pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone who has thought this through and is letting you know the system works.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 院長経験者の枠も足したい。部数の関係上、印刷物は最小限で。
lines.en: I'd like to add a slot for ex-directors. We'll keep print runs minimal given the constraints.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Strategic—each phrase deliberate. Slight weight on 「ex-directors」, then lighter on the practical constraint. Speaking to someone she trusts to follow the logic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 直行便で次の地域へ移動する候補者、配備の段取り、確認します。
lines.en: For candidates heading nonstop to the next region, I'll confirm the deployment schedule.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. No rush. Concrete—he's already mentally running through the checklist. Warm acknowledgment that he's noted the priority and will handle it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Quiet, genuine. Brief exhale of relief. The gratitude of someone who knows they can trust the work to be done. No need to oversell.
